sentences.text: 麻绳专挑细处断，厄运只找苦命人。
sentences.translation: Hemp ropes are specifically chosen to break at the thinnest point, misfortune only seeks out those with bitter destinies.

sentences.text: 秋天的冻雨根本不会可怜任何辛苦劳作的人，执意要在泔水工本就沉重的肩膀上再添冷气。
sentences.translation: The freezing rain in autumn will not pity anyone who works hard, insisting on adding cold air to the already heavy burden on their shoulders.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes how the freezing rain in autumn does not show mercy to hardworking people, emphasizing the additional burden it brings to their already heavy shoulders.

sentences.text: 泔水工是个小青年，身上的雨衣估计比他的岁数都大。
